output.text: Hi, it's me. Card payments and phones are down across the whole business district. So the shops are closing early. I'm walking over to Riverside to get signal.
Hello, I'm at the Riverside Pharmacy and the card machine is down. Could you send me some money by bank transfer so I can pay for the prescription?
My mother lives at Elm Park Care Home and I can't get through to them at all. She's on oxygen monitoring. Is anyone actually checking on the residents?
There's a man collapsed at the bus stop on River Street. He's not responding and I don't think he's breathing. Please send an ambulance.
Hiya, just letting you know I'm working from the cafe on Riverside today. The office internet is down. Ring me if you need anything.
Control, Unit 1-4, traffic signals are out at the junction of King Street and Mill Lane, requesting a second unit for traffic control. Over.
